name: audio.mix
title: Mix (tracks, buses, pan)
summary: Declarative track/bus mixer: places clips sample-accurately on tracks, sums them to an exact length, optional per-track fx, level, sidechain and master stage. Plain float sum by default.
description: Sums audio clips on named tracks to an exact length. Processing order: (1) track_defaults are merged under each track with the same name; (2) every clip's `at` is resolved (seconds or a timespec against `timeline`); (3) each distinct (src, offset_s, duration_s, fx) is decoded once; (4) optional per-clip leveling; (5) per clip gain, linear fades, the pan law, then mix at its sample position; (6) track fx; (7) track gain_db; (8) optional track `level`; (9) optional sidechains; (10) mute; (11) bus fx and gain, then the master sum = buses + tracks without a bus; (12) optional master fx/gain/loudness; (13) fit to N samples and write. N = round(duration_s*sample_rate) or the latest clip end. Defaults are neutral: no ducking, no normalisation, no limiter; the default output is 32-bit float WAV so a sum above 0 dBFS does not clip. Pan law: mono into stereo is equal-power. Pan 0 gives 0.7071 per channel (matching ffmpeg's mono upmix); stereo into stereo at pan 0 is the identity; into mono a stereo clip becomes (L+R)/2 and pan is ignored.

preset.description: Optional named mix preset; its settings are merged under this request (the request wins).

sample_rate.description: Mix sample rate in Hz. Default 48000.

duration_s.description: Exact output length in seconds (rounded to whole samples). Omit to use the end of the latest clip.

timeline.description: Optional timeline.json ref; enables string `at` timespecs (scene, cue, bar, beat).

track_defaults.description: Per-track-name settings merged UNDER each track with that name (the request's track wins). Presets use this.

tracks.description: Tracks to sum. Each track holds clips and is processed independently.

buses.description: Named sub-mixes. Tracks with `bus` sum here before the buses are summed into the master.

gain_db.description: Bus fader in dB, applied after the bus fx. Default 0.

fx.description: Optional ffmpeg -af chain applied to the summed bus (for example "volume=6dB").

sidechain.description: Optional sidechain compressors. Each one ducks `target` using `key` as the trigger. Omit for no ducking.

key.description: Track name whose signal triggers the compressor.

lookahead_s.description: Seconds the key is advanced to look ahead. Default 0.

master.description: Final stage. Absent, or neutral (no fx, gain_db 0, no loudness), means the mix is not touched.

loudness.description: Optional loudness target for the master stage.

method.description: How to reach the target: a measured gain plus limiter, or ffmpeg loudnorm. Default "gain+limiter".

lra.description: Loudness range target in LU (loudnorm). Default 11.

format.description: Output WAV encoding: 32-bit float (no clipping), 24-bit or 16-bit. Default "wav32f".

stems.description: Also write stems/<track>.wav (32-bit float) for every track, post-level and pre-bus. Default false.

preview_mp3.description: Also write a 192 kbps preview.mp3. Default false.

level.description: Loudness-relative track level, applied after the track fx and gain_db.

lufs.description: Absolute target integrated LUFS for the track.

relative_to.description: Another track name to be measured against.

lu.description: Offset in LU from relative_to's level.

clipLeveling.description: Per-clip loudness levelling, applied before fades and pan.

to.description: Target: a LUFS number, or "median" to use the median of the non-silent clips. Default "median".

tolerance_lu.description: Clips already this close to the target get 0 dB. Default 0.75.

min_db.description: Lower clamp for a clip gain, in dB. Default -9.

max_db.description: Upper clamp for a clip gain, in dB. Default 6.

trackDefaults.description: Fields applied UNDER a track with this name (the request's track wins).

gain_db.description: Default track fader in dB for matching tracks.

fx.description: Default track ffmpeg -af chain for matching tracks.

bus.description: Default bus name for matching tracks.

level.description: Default loudness-relative level for matching tracks.

clip_leveling.description: Default per-clip loudness levelling for matching tracks.

src.description: Audio file to place: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output-path> or pin:<name>.

at.description: Where the clip starts: seconds (number) or a timespec string ("scene", "scene#cue.end", "bar:4") resolved against `timeline`.

offset_s.description: Seconds into the source to start reading. Default 0.

duration_s.description: Seconds of source to use. Omit to use the rest of the source.

gain_db.description: Clip gain in dB, applied before fades and pan. Default 0.

pan.description: Stereo position, -1 hard left .. 1 hard right (balance for stereo, equal-power for mono into stereo). Default 0.

fade_in_s.description: Linear fade-in length in seconds. Default 0.

fade_out_s.description: Linear fade-out length in seconds. Default 0.

fx.description: Optional per-clip ffmpeg -af chain applied while decoding (for example "volume=-3dB"). Source filters such as movie are refused.

name.description: Optional label for the clip (informational only).
Track name, unique per mix; used by bus, level, sidechain and stem file names.

gain_db.description: Track fader in dB, applied after the track fx. Default 0 (unity).

mute.description: When true the track is not summed into the mix (it can still key a sidechain). Default false.

fx.description: Optional ffmpeg -af chain applied to the whole track (for example "volume=6dB").

bus.description: Name of a declared bus to sum this track into instead of the master. Omit for the master.

level.description: Optional loudness-relative level for this track.

clip_leveling.description: Optional per-clip loudness levelling for this track.

clips.description: Clips placed on this track. May be empty.
